senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to be great; to boast,] to acknowledge the authority of, submit to.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 27:9">Ex. R. s. 27</cite> (ref. to <he>התרפס ורהב</he>, <cite ref="Proverbs 6:3">Prov. VI, 3</cite>) <he>התרפס … והמליכם עליך</he> be trodden in the dust of the feet of those greater than thyself and make them kings over thee; v. <cite ref="T00272"><he>רַהַב</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:5:1">Cant. R. to VI, 5</cite> (expl. <he>הרהיבני</he> <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:5:1">ib.</cite>) <he>שהם הִרְהִיבוּנִי הם המליכו וכ׳</he> for they (the children at the Red Sea) did me homage, made me king over them, saying (<cite ref="Exodus 15:18">Ex. XV, 18</cite>), ‘the Lord shall reign &c.; <cite ref="Exodus 15:18">ib.</cite> <he>שהם הרהיבוני הם קבלו וכ׳</he> for they (the elders) did me homage, they accepted my rulership over them at Sinai (<cite ref="Exodus 24:7">Ex. XXIV, 7</cite>).
